title: Rumored crash in Chinese territory

tellings.quote: And I've heard a lot of rumors when I did business in China, which I did for years. >> Yeah. >> With the Chinese government that there was something that crashed >> in Chinese territory. I think the Russians got it though.

plain: Something unknown is rumoured to have crashed on Chinese soil, and the Russians, not the Chinese, may have ended up with it. The author Peter Levenda says he heard these rumours over years of doing business with the Chinese government, adding, "I think the Russians got it though." If true, it would mean the US is not the only country to have recovered such a craft.
